name: Puhui Wealth Investment Management Co., Ltd.
summary: Puhui Wealth Investment Management Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, offers third-party wealth management services across the People's Republic of China. The company distributes a variety of financial instruments, such as private equity funds, securities-based investment funds, and private placement debt products, primarily to affluent individuals and small to medium-sized businesses. Furthermore, it provides custom trust arrangements and tailored asset management programs. Puhui also manages investment portfolios for both individual and corporate clients, in addition to furnishing comprehensive investment advisory services. The firm was founded in 2013 and its main office is located in Beijing, China.
